claude.sample_unit: patient education materials (prostate, bladder, kidney cancer)

links.outcome: Readability grade level of patient materials, with and without literacy-adjusted prompting
links.effect: Default ChatGPT grade level 12.16 exceeded recommended level; with readability-adjusted prompting (ChatGPT-a) it improved to 7.50, and only ChatGPT-a retained high quality.
links.quote: When adjusted for user education level (ChatGPT-a and Epic Easy to Read), readability improved (7.50 and 3.53), but only ChatGPT-a retained high quality.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of patient education materials versus recommended 6-8th grade
links.effect: Epic met recommended grade level, while UCF and ChatGPT exceeded it (5.81 vs. 8.44 vs. 12.16, p < 0.001).
